---
title: Margin caption chunk option in formats without a margin column
engine: knitr
format:
  beamer:
    # write the .tex only, no PDF compile
    output-ext: tex
  revealjs:
    # keep the figure markup instead of a stretched image with a `p.caption`
    auto-stretch: false
_quarto:
  tests:
    beamer:
      ensureFileRegexMatches:
        -
          # the caption stays an ordinary caption (`.` stands for a backslash)
          - '.caption\{.label\{fig-a\}Figure caption text\}'
        -
          - 'sidecaption'
          - 'sidenotes'
      printsMessage:
        level: INFO
        regex: "Caption location 'margin' is not supported in beamer output"
    revealjs:
      ensureHtmlElements:
        -
          - 'figcaption.quarto-float-caption-bottom'
        -
          - '.quarto-float-caption-margin'
          - '.margin-caption'
---

A `fig-cap-location: margin` chunk option reaches the cell as a `.fig-cap-location-margin` class, which is forwarded to the figure as a margin caption. In formats without a margin column it gets the same bottom-caption fallback as the document option.

```{r}
#| label: fig-a
#| fig-cap: Figure caption text
#| fig-cap-location: margin
plot(1)
```
